There is a whale that sings, and no one sings back.
In nineteen eighty-nine, Navy microphones built to hunt submarines picked up a strange song in the Pacific.
A whale, singing at fifty-two hertz.
Other big whales sing far lower.
For twelve years, scientists followed the song across the ocean.
And in all those years, they never heard a second voice like it.
No one has ever even seen it.
They call it the loneliest whale in the world.
Some of us know that feeling.
Jenny always answers, day or night.
